description.en: Parameter barcode 69053 selects the active job slot; scan the official slot barcode.
description.pt: Código de parâmetro 69053 seleciona slot de job ativo; leia o código oficial do slot.

source.applicability: FS40-WA20Z4-2C00W; same-type replacement and software/firmware compatibility must be checked

description.en: Parameter barcode 69054 selects the startup job slot; separate from the active slot.
description.pt: Código de parâmetro 69054 seleciona slot de inicialização; independente do slot ativo.

source.applicability: FS40-WA20Z4-2C00W; same-type replacement and software/firmware compatibility must be checked

description.en: Check network visibility, Aurora Focus firewall permissions and USB RNDIS driver. For intermittent USB connection, reseat cable and tighten screws.
description.pt: Confira visibilidade na rede, permissões do firewall para Aurora Focus e driver RNDIS USB. Em conexão USB intermitente, recoloque cabo e aperte parafusos.

source.applicability: FS40-WA20Z4-2C00W; same-type replacement and software/firmware compatibility must be checked

description.en: Remove all cables, restore power, allow approximately one minute, then retry discovery in Aurora Focus or Web HMI.
description.pt: Remova todos os cabos, restabeleça a alimentação, aguarde cerca de um minuto e tente a descoberta no Aurora Focus ou Web HMI.

description.en: In View Devices select connected device, choose device configuration/jobs/both, then Create Backup and save a file. Backup interrupts the running job.
description.pt: Em View Devices selecione dispositivo conectado, escolha configuração/jobs/ambos, clique Create Backup e salve arquivo. Backup interrompe o job em execução.

source.applicability: FS40-WA20Z4-2C00W; same-type replacement and software/firmware compatibility must be checked

description.en: Select connected device in View Devices, select backup file and click Restore Device; the device reboots. Confirm hardware/firmware compatibility before replacement.
description.pt: Selecione dispositivo conectado em View Devices, selecione arquivo de backup e clique Restore Device; dispositivo reinicia. Confira compatibilidade de hardware/firmware antes da substituição.

source.applicability: FS40-WA20Z4-2C00W; same-type replacement and software/firmware compatibility must be checked

description.en: Back up first. Remove all power, hold TRIG, reconnect power, hold about 20 seconds until the documented LED transition, then release within 5 seconds.
description.pt: Faça backup antes. Remova alimentação, segure TRIG, reconecte energia, segure cerca de 20 segundos até transição de LEDs documentada e solte em até 5 segundos.

source.applicability: FS40-WA20Z4-2C00W; same-type replacement and software/firmware compatibility must be checked
